patch.value: Completed-task transcripts accept terminal refusals and contradictory recovery metadata

Greptile and CodeRabbit exact-head review on PR #1133 found that the public transcript parser can accept a task ending in refusal, successful steps can carry refusal-only metadata, and the retry-option fixture lacks its recovery_for edge. Enforce terminal-success topology and mutually exclusive refusal/recovery metadata in the SDK contract and replay corpus.

Every completed task terminates in a non-refusal output; successful outputs reject refusal-only metadata; every corrected retry binds to the refusal it recovers; adversarial parser and replay regressions pass
The public SDK transcript contract cannot represent an unsuccessfully terminated completed task or contradictory refusal metadata.
Exact-head review demonstrated parser-admissible terminal refusals, success/refusal metadata ambiguity, and an unbound retry fixture.
